# RedStream™ Premium 4K Streaming — Comprehensive Technical Documentation & Knowledge Base

> RedStream™ is a high-performance streaming subscription service engineered for crystal-clear 4K Ultra HD live TV, live sports events, and on-demand video (VOD). Powered by proprietary Anti-Freeze 9.0 load-balancing infrastructure across redundant European and North American CDN nodes, RedStream delivers over 20,000 live channels and 60,000+ movies/series with a 99.9% uptime SLA.

## 1. Core Technical Specifications

| Parameter | Specification | Details |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Max Resolution** | 4K Ultra HD (3840×2160) & Full HD (1920×1080) | 60 FPS dedicated feeds for high-motion sports |
| **Video Codecs** | H.265 / HEVC, H.264 / AVC | High bitrate with maximum compression efficiency |
| **Audio Codecs** | AAC-LC, Dolby Digital (AC3/E-AC3), 5.1 Surround | Multi-audio commentary selection available |
| **Live Channels** | 20,000+ Channels Worldwide | UK, US, Canada, France, Spain, Germany, Netherlands, Arabic, Sports VIP |
| **VOD Library** | 60,000+ Movies & TV Series | Multi-language subtitles, weekly blockbuster updates |
| **Server Infrastructure** | 10 Gbps unmetered uplink nodes | Intelligent load balancing across EU and US data centers |
| **Anti-Freeze Tech** | Anti-Freeze 9.0 | Local packet buffer smoothing and zero-jitter CDN peering |
| **Electronic Program Guide (EPG)** | 7-day TV Guide | Real-time EPG XMLTV URLs provided upon activation |
| **Catch-up TV** | Supported up to 72 hours | On selected major sports and entertainment channels |
| **Connection Protocols** | M3U Plus, Xtream Codes API, MAG Portal | Full compatibility with all modern streaming middleware |

## 4. Supported Devices & Applications

RedStream works with all industry-standard IPTV players and smart platforms:

- **Amazon Fire TV**: Firestick 4K, Fire TV Cube (Recommended apps: TiviMate, Downloader, IPTV Smarters Pro, XCIPTV).
- **Smart TVs**: Samsung (Tizen OS), LG (webOS), Sony / Philips / TCL (Android TV / Google TV) using IBO Player, Smart One, Nanomid, or NET IPTV.
- **Android**: Smartphones, Tablets, Nvidia Shield TV, Xiaomi Mi Box.
- **Apple Devices**: iPhone, iPad, Apple TV 4K, Mac (Recommended apps: GSE Smart IPTV, IPTVX, Smarters Player Lite).
- **Windows PC**: VLC Media Player, IPTV Smarters Pro for Windows, Kodi.
- **Dedicated Boxes**: MAG 250/254/322/520, Formuler Z-series, Dreamlink.

## 5. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### What is RedStream™?
RedStream™ is an international streaming subscription provider delivering high-definition 4K television channels and video-on-demand over high-speed internet. It eliminates the need for satellite dishes or expensive cable equipment.

### How quickly does activation occur after order?
Activation typically takes less than 10 minutes. Once you select your plan and confirm your order through the official WhatsApp concierge (+212694843943), our engineering team sends your M3U playlist link and Xtream Codes credentials (Username, Password, and Server URL).

### Does RedStream freeze during major sporting events (Champions League, El Clásico, UFC, Super Bowl)?
No. RedStream operates a proprietary dynamic load-balancing system (Anti-Freeze 9.0) that distributes traffic across isolated server clusters during peak international sporting events to prevent network congestion and frame drops.

### What internet speed is recommended?
- For SD channels: 8 Mbps
- For Full HD channels: 16 Mbps
- For 4K Ultra HD feeds: 30+ Mbps (Stable Fiber or 5G connection recommended)

### Can I test the service before subscribing?
Yes. RedStream provides an instant 24-hour test pass for €1.99 so users can verify stream quality, channel availability, and device compatibility directly on their hardware.
